'''Kanata's Poochyena''' ('''カナタ ポチエナ''' ''Kanata's Pochiena'') is one of the main characters in [[Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪]]. He's the younger brother of {{ccp|Mightyena}}.

==History==
Poochyena is introduced along with his Trainer when Torchic mistakes Poochyena as a Prince Charming.

==Personality and characteristics==
Poochyena doesn't get along with {{TP|Haruka|Torchic}} at all; he calls her "shorty" and she calls him "hick-Poochy". However, he congratulates her for doing well in a {{pkmn|Contest}}, and comforts her when she's upset at times.
